label: mcl_core_log_birch
reference_prompt: Create a close visual reference for the bark-covered side of a mature birch trunk in a cool grounded dark-fantasy woodland. Preserve birch's unmistakable pale papery bark character while making it physically rich and aged: layered off-white sheets, horizontal lenticel marks, curled thin flakes, charcoal-gray scars and darker rough bark emerging around old wounds and mature sections. Moisture and dirt softly stain lower recesses. Keep the palette muted ivory, bone-gray and subdued charcoal rather than brilliant white. Avoid zebra stripes, perfectly clean decorative birch, excessive peeling ribbons, moss coverage or painted black marks. The material should feel delicate at the surface yet tough beneath, distinctly birch and clearly part of an old weathered world. Do not imitate the source texture's pattern.
